ns2:section.sectionText: Students enrolled in this section must concurrently enroll ME 360 (69390) Signal Processing. James Scholar status IS NOT required to register. This ME 199 may not be used in the sequence to replace a MechSE/Technical Elective credit. ME students must obtain department approval from staff in 154 MEB to drop this course after the last day to add a class.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
